evidence.note: CoDE-Stop stops reasoning when either a ramping confidence threshold is crossed or an early-step-weighted 'degeneration score' of accumulated confidence instability exceeds a threshold, targeting both trajectories that are already done and trajectories that are going nowhere, and its evaluation is the archive's first independent head-to-head of RCPD and Answer Convergence under one protocol.
evidence.title: Early Stopping for Large Reasoning Models via Confidence Dynamics
